name: learning to cook as a beginner
description: A beginner who never learned to cook asks where to start, then how to learn, then for one easy dish. Verifies that cooking guidance comes from the offline knowledge layer (cooking_basics fact) with a substantive reply, that follow-up learning questions keep routing to knowledge, and that practical tips turns answer directly rather than bouncing to a generic fallback.

turns.text: I never learned how to cook, where do I even start?
How do I learn to cook?
Any easy cooking tips for a beginner?

expected.finalTurn: Turn 1: cooking question routes to knowledge and returns the cooking_basics fact (start with three to five dishes, basic pantry). Turn 2: the learning-phrased question still answers from the same fact via the knowledge override. Turn 3: a tips request with framing words returns the fact again with practical guidance.
expected.behavior: All three turns are knowledge-driven: the cooking_basics fact matches on kitchen words (cook, cooking) plus framing words (where do I start, how do I, tips). Replies are substantive, non-error, and never use generic fallbacks.
